intro: Convert megapascals to PSI accurately for hydraulic cylinder ratings, concrete compressive strength (MPa), tire placards, and piping hydrostatic tests. One megapascal (MPa, meaning 1,000,000 pascals or 1 N/mm²) equals 145.037738 pounds per square inch. To convert MPa to psi quickly, multiply megapascals by 145.03774 above or look up standard pressure values from 0.1 MPa to 400 MPa below.

mistakesAndEdgeCases.title: MPa vs. Mpsi, Megabar & Gauge vs. Absolute Pressure
items: Do not confuse MPa (megapascals, 145.038 psi) with Mpsi/msi (megapounds per square inch = 1,000,000 psi) or megabar (10⁶ bar ≈ 14.5 million psi)—those units differ by orders of magnitude.

Pressure gauges read gauge pressure (psig) relative to local air pressure (~14.696 psi or 0.1013 MPa at sea level); add atmospheric pressure when converting gauge readings to absolute pressure (psia).

faqs.question: What does MPa stand for in pressure?
faqs.answer: MPa stands for megapascal, an SI metric unit of pressure equal to 1,000,000 pascals (1,000 kPa, 10 bar, or 1 N/mm²). In US/imperial units, 1 MPa equals 145.03774 psi.

faqs.question: How do you convert MPa to psi?
faqs.answer: Multiply the pressure in megapascals by 145.037738 (psi = MPa × 145.037738). For example, 5 MPa × 145.037738 = 725.18869 psi.

faqs.question: What is 0.1 MPa in psi?
faqs.answer: 0.1 MPa equals 14.50377 psi (equivalent to 1 bar, or just under standard sea-level atmospheric pressure of 14.7 psi).
